senses.gloss: (Shaf. of גרר; cmp. נגר) to run, flow.—Part. pass. שָׁגוּר; f. שְׁגוּרָה fluent, spoken without hesitation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:5">Ber. V, 5</cite> <he>אם ש׳ תפלתי וכ׳</he> if my prayer is fluent in my mouth, I know &c., v. <cite ref="I00859"><he>טָרַף</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:3">Tosef. ib. III, 3</cite> <he>שָׁגְרָה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>שגורה</he>).—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15:2">Cant. R. to I, 15</cite> <he>שוגרת</he>, v. infra.]
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>כיון ששִׁיגְּרוּ … בפיהם וכ׳</he> when they recited (these verses) the whole night with fluency, they considered it a good sign &c.

senses.gloss: to make run, to send. Tanḥ. Mick. 8 תפוש … ושַׁגֵּר אותם לפני arrest them and send them up before me; Gen. R. s. 91.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:6">Ib.</cite> <he>וש׳ בשבילם וכ׳</he> and sent (messengers) out for them to hunt them up &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:9">Tosef. Sabb. XIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:9">XIV</cite>), 9 <he>ולהיפרכוס שלהן ש׳ לו וכ׳</he> and to their commander he sent a present of fifty denars.
<cite ref="Berakhot 51a">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>מְשַׁגְּרוֹ לאנשי וכ׳</he> he sends it as a gift to his household.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 59b:21">Snh. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>אחד משגרו וכ׳</he> he sent out one (serpent) to the south &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 35b">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>שִׁגְּרוּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00350"><he>נוֹטָרִין</he></cite> a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְשׁוּגָּר</he>; f. <he>מְשׁוּגֶּרֶת</he>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:1">Cant. R. to IV, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00317"><he>רוֹגְלִית</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:15:2">ib. to I, 15</cite> <he>שוגרת</he> corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: [to speak fluently,] to improvise a prayer, change the established form. Y. Ber. V, 9ᶜ שליח צבור שה׳ שתים וכ׳ if a reader improvises two or three sections (of the Prayer of Benedictions), we do not make him go back and recite the established form.
